alternatives.label: Yarn Ledger

typography.font_family: Nunito, tabular-nums for all rupee amounts

alternatives.reason: The warm cream paper, terracotta and rust accents, and deep brown ink echo a hand-kept craft ledger, so the seller's money records feel like a personal notebook rather than a generic finance dashboard.

alternatives.label: Monsoon Cashbook
alternatives.reason: Ink-blue and slate neutrals on a cool grey ground give a sober bank-statement clarity, with the signal orange danger tone reserved strictly for overdue and shortage states so those warnings are the only warm colour on screen.

alternatives.label: Screenprint Stall
alternatives.reason: Marigold, deep teal and off-white borrowed from a market-stall screenprint table give the seller a loud, high-contrast working tool where chunky headlines, flat status chips and clear rupee figures read quickly on a phone.

alternatives.label: Late Night Ledger
alternatives.reason: A low-glare aubergine-charcoal dark theme with lavender text keeps evening reconciliation calm, while amber is reserved for overdue money so urgent balances stand out without alarming the rest of the screen.
